  <action>
Create `src/app/utils/category-normalization.ts` exporting a single pure function
`normalizeCategory(raw: string | undefined | null): string | undefined` (per D-14: one shared helper,
applied consistently at every entry point rather than re-derived per call site).

Transform contract (this is the canonical rule — plan 03-06 depends on exactly this behavior):
- `undefined` / `null` / a string that is empty after trimming → returns `undefined`
- Otherwise: trim the outer whitespace, collapse runs of internal whitespace to a single space, then
  Title-Case each whitespace-separated word (first character uppercased, remaining characters lowercased).
- Examples that MUST hold: `'hats'` → `'Hats'`; `'HATS'` → `'Hats'`; `'  hAtS  '` → `'Hats'`;
  `'sci fi props'` → `'Sci Fi Props'`; `'Humans'` → `'Humans'`; `'attachment'` → `'Attachment'`;
  `'3d objects'` → `'3d Objects'`.
- Idempotence is a hard requirement: `normalizeCategory(normalizeCategory(x)) === normalizeCategory(x)`
  for every input. This matters because the helper is applied at multiple boundaries (metadata load,
  IndexedDB read, IndexedDB write, category name save) and values will pass through it more than once.
- Title-Case rather than first-char-only is deliberate: first-char-only (today's behavior at
  `image-metadata.service.ts:72`) leaves `'HATS'` and `'Hats'` as distinct strings, which is the exact
  mismatch RACE-04 exists to eliminate.

Do NOT import anything from `@angular/core` — this is a plain module, mirroring
`src/app/utils/adult-content-filter.ts`.

Create `src/app/utils/category-normalization.spec.ts` covering: each example pair above, the
undefined/null/blank cases, the idempotence property (assert over the full example set), and that the
eight canonical category names already used as defaults in `category.service.ts`
(`Humans`, `Animals`, `Buildings`, `Objects`, `Custom`, `Tools`, `Accessories`, `Decorative`) are
returned unchanged. Use a plain `describe`/`it` structure — no `TestBed` is needed for a pure module.
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>CHROME_BIN=/home/user/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1223/chrome-linux64/chrome pnpm exec ng test --no-watch --browsers=ChromeHeadless --include='**/category-normalization.spec.ts' 2>&amp;1 | tail -5</automated>
  </verify>
  <acceptance_criteria>

  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>`normalizeCategory` exists as a tested pure function with a documented, idempotent Title-Case contract, ready for plan 03-06 to wire into every category boundary.</done>
